---
title: Appendix sections
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
  html: default
number-sections: true
bibliography: appendix.bib
filters:
  - typst-extras
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          if [ "$EXTENSION_TEST_FORMAT" != typst ]; then exit 0; fi
          dash="$(printf '\342\200\224')"
          text="$(pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr '\n' ' ')"
          for expected in "Appendix A $dash Extra" "Appendix B $dash More" 'Figure A.1: Extra square' 'Figure B.1: More square' 'Theorem 1 (A body theorem)' 'Theorem A.1 (An appendix theorem)' 'Lemma A.1 (An appendix lemma)' 'Theorem A.2 (A second appendix theorem)' 'See Appendix A for more' 'see Appendix A.1 for detail' 'see Figure A.1' '(A.1)' 'Figure 1: Body square' 'Bare A and bare A.1.' 'Custom Annex A.1.'; do
            printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qF "$expected" || { echo "missing: $expected"; exit 1; }
          done
          printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qE "Intro.*Methods.*Appendix A $dash Extra.*Appendix B $dash More.*Bibliography" || { echo "wrong order"; exit 1; }
          test "$(printf '%s' "$text" | grep -o 'Methods' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo "Methods is not once"; exit 1; }
          ! printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qE "(Appendix [A-Z] $dash|[0-9]) Bibliography" || { echo "the bibliography title is numbered"; exit 1; }
          typ="${EXTENSION_TEST_INPUT%.qmd}.typ"
          resets="$(awk '/^#typst-extras-part-start\("appendix"/ { part = 1; next } part && /^= / { exit } part && /typst-extras-reset/ { n++ } END { print n + 0 }' "$typ")"
          test "$resets" -eq 0 || { echo "$resets resets between the appendix part start and the first appendix heading"; exit 1; }
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - - '#typst-extras-part-start\("appendix"'
          - '#show ref: typst-extras-ref'
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<section[^>]*class="[^"]*appendix', 'Extra']
        - ['typst-extras']
---
